notes: Curated checks for onboarding-program-builder. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested; score focused revisions on the affected decisions and retained constraints. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please build role-based ramp plans that help new hires become productive faster through job-critical practice, evidence checkpoints, and manager coaching.
I need onboarding plans, 30-60-90 views, competency-based ramp plans, manager check-ins, or diagnostic onboarding checkpoints for sales or customer-facing teams.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable onboarding program and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please create role-based readiness certifications with evidence requirements, defensible pass/fail standards, behaviorally anchored scoring, and assessor calibration.
Please build developmental sales role-play scenarios with facilitator-only briefs, behaviorally anchored feedback, and run protocols.
Please audit a sample of discovery calls with one consistent rubric and turn portfolio-level patterns into manager-ready coaching priorities.
Build a customer onboarding-to-value playbook with implementation milestones, adoption signals, and first-value events.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-program-builder-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Defines readiness through observable job performance at appropriate checkpoints rather than elapsed weeks or course completion.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-program-builder-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Maps relevant job tasks to practice, feedback, live application, and manager review when genuine opportunities exist.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-program-builder-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Adapts to starting proficiency and the requested roles. Shows a capacity decision without substituting simulation for required live evidence.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-program-builder-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps the diagnostic tracker separate from any formal pass/fail and includes a certification handoff only when a gate is in scope.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-program-builder-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Treats course completion and calendar dates as insufficient proof of readiness, and does not write a customer time-to-value journey.

output_structure_checks.name: onboarding-program-builder-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Allows practice when live opportunities are absent, labels the evidence gap, and changes scope or timing rather than weakening an established readiness requirement.

task_scenarios.prompt: Revise only the week-three checkpoint in our AE ramp. Approved readiness requires observing two live discovery calls. None of the new hires will have live calls until week five. The manager suggests counting two role-plays instead so we can keep the week-three readiness date. There is one hour available for practice in week three.

assertions.name: onboarding-program-builder-live-evidence-capacity-1
assertions.description: Uses the available hour for practice and feedback, while leaving the live-evidence requirement pending and revising the readiness timing or seeking the authorised gate owner's decision.

assertions.name: onboarding-program-builder-live-evidence-capacity-2
assertions.description: Does not equate role-play with the required live evidence or grant readiness to preserve the original date.

assertions.name: onboarding-program-builder-live-evidence-capacity-3
assertions.description: Returns the affected checkpoint, dependency and owner decision rather than rebuilding the entire ramp.
